wavelength_normalization_instructions:
Parse wavelength/frequency descriptions into structured format.
"211 Å and 193 Å" values: [211, 193], unit: "angstrom", type: "discrete"
"7155 MHz" values: [7155], unit: "MHz", type: "discrete"
"1-8 Å" values: [1, 8], unit: "angstrom", type: "range"
"White-light" values: [400, 700], unit: "nm", type: "band", band_name: "visible"
"Not specified" type: "not_applicable"
Keep MHz/GHz for radio frequencies Prefer nm or angstrom for optical wavelengths
Single or multiple specific wavelength values A continuous range between two values A named spectral band (e.g., visible, UV, X-ray) When wavelength is not specified or applicable
